recap: The team had to build a snail out of dominoes before the clock ran out. Priya drew the sketch and split the strokes: Maya took the body, Tom the spiral, Leo the stalks. The stalks kept failing. Leo's dry run showed they wouldn't catch, and Priya kept redrawing them while Maya warned that the neck still came off too steeply. With minutes left, Tom moved to the neck, and Leo ended up finishing the spiral. Then Priya spotted the real problem: the body never fed into the shell. "The shell starts at this lower-left end," she said, and Leo laid it up the right side and round. Tom's squint report read the table as "a long worm with its head up." When time was up, 83 of 110 dominoes fell. Everyone called it a snail. The blind judges guessed a stick figure, a wave, and a broken branch.
